motion: Topic: Peter has named a four-layer spine for assembling a head of consciousness: nouns (located things) → verbs (actions as bets) → predict-vs-perceive (diff = learning signal) → phenomenology → consciousness. Each Derek body-verb ladders up to this. Is this spine genuinely a research program that could fail, or is it dressed-up panpsychism that cannot be falsified? Defend or attack.
